create_Pop2PianoTokenizer: create a Pop2PianoTokenizer instance from a vocab.json file with custom default_velocity and num_bars settings
convert_tokens_to_notes: convert relative token ids to midi notes using Pop2PianoTokenizer.relative_tokens_ids_to_notes method
encode_notes_to_tokens: encode midi notes into transformer token ids using Pop2PianoTokenizer.encode_plus method
decode_tokens_to_midi: decode transformer token ids back to pretty_midi objects using Pop2PianoTokenizer.batch_decode method
save_tokenizer_vocab: save the Pop2PianoTokenizer vocabulary dictionary to a specified directory path
